option reply to author):
>Seirhune wrote:
>> Could Bundi be used in conjunction with Blood Rage/Fury?

>No. Blood Rage doesn't say "make a melee weapon strike" or "make a hand strike"
>or otherwise permit the incorporation of another strike effect. It simply is a
>hand strike itself.

Text of Blood Rage (third edition, previous texts are different):
Only usable at close range. [tha] Strike: >>make a hand strike<< ...

Bundi would be useable if B.R. text was not Strike:...? If it is
correct I cannot use Bundi with Anesthetic Touch.

> Bundi would be useable if B.R. text was not Strike:...? If it is

Yes, you cannot use a Bundi with it.

Anesthetic Touch: "[obe] Strike: hand strike."
